newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police arrest Venezuelan rebel chief.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police arrest Venezuelan rebel chief.

text.p: Colombian police arrested a Venezuelan who deserted his country's National Guard and joined Colombia's largest guerrilla army, officials said on Monday.
Former Lieutenant Colonel Javier Leon Paolini was captured in Colombia's eastern Meta province on Sunday, national police chief Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano said.

Serrano alleged Paolini had sold Venezuelan official-issue weapons to the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) in 1993 before quitting the National Guard to head a FARC column that operated in the Colombia-Venezuelan border region.
The arrest comes at a time of renewed border tensions between the two nations.

Last week Venezuelan border guards opened fire on a Colombian civilian boat on the River Arauaca, killing a 3-year-old boy and injuring eight others. The incident sparked an exchange of diplomatic letters.
Both countries have traded accusations in recent months about failure to crack down on guerrilla forces operating in the frontier region.
